data.one_liner: Custom Flutter widgets for cleaner and easier grouped radio buttons and checkboxes
data.what_it_does: Provides custom widgets like CustomRadioButton and CustomCheckBoxGroup that simplify creating grouped radio buttons and checkboxes with styling and state management options. It allows vertical and horizontal orientations, custom spacing, text styles, and programmatic selection/unselection.
use_when: You need styled radio button groups or checkbox groups in your forms
You want to manage grouped selection states easily using custom labels and values
avoid_when: You require complex FormBuilder validation integrations that use other form packages
You only need standard platform-native single checkboxes or radio buttons without grouping
strengths: Simplifies creation of grouped radio buttons and checkboxes
Supports programmatic selection and unselection using GlobalKeys
Offers layout flexibility including wrap and scrollable options
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-built grouped button configurations
Relies on GlobalKeys for programmatic state updates rather than direct controller parameters
